name: Alcove
soft_passes: #1 baked rounded-rect bezel carries its own radius inside the system squircle — frame-within-mask, risks a subtle double-corner
#4 survives 16px with no smear but reads as a generic dark-tile-with-purple-glow, low differentiation
#5 two implied light sources (top-lit bezel + bottom-emitting field); coheres only as a 'lit recessed screen'
#9 custom hybrid — mild skeuomorphic device-bezel quotation around a flat modern gradient, no single system era
#11 framed-glow device is nameable but thin; one gesture, leans on color to differentiate
failures: #3 silhouette: filled solid black it is just a rounded square — frame is already black, interior has no discrete figure; identity lost when color is discarded
#10 variant robustness: identity is background-color-dependent with no carrying glyph; the cover's grayscale wordmark badge is the live mono variant and collapses to a generic dark-framed tile

palette.background: ramp #25126C->#F7A5F8 vertical (deep indigo-violet top -> pale magenta-pink bottom); bezel #141414 near-black frame

light_model: Ambiguous two-source: faint top-edge specular on the bezel (light from top) plus an inner field brightening toward the bottom (bottom-up emitted glow). Coheres only read as a lit screen recessed in a frame. No baked drop shadow (system-supplied).
layer_stack: black beveled bezel frame (faint top-edge specular)
recessed inner field: vertical violet->pink ramp
devices: framed recessed glow ('alcove') — beveled near-black bezel wrapping a luminous inner panel; literal read of the app name and the Dynamic-Island/notch nook
inverted glow ramp — light rises from the bottom edge, opposite Big-Sur sky logic
wallpaper-echo palette — violet->pink field mirrors the Monterey-style desktop the app overlays
rhymes_hint: dark-bezel framed-screen/framed-window utilities executed as a solid recessed bezel; notch/menu-bar/wallpaper utilities dropping a saturated gradient inside a device frame; synthwave violet->magenta->pink ramp family
notes: Only a 204x204 web render was available (not the 1024 master) — bezel bevel and any Icon Composer glass layering are below the resolution floor; edge treatment estimated. Secondary contested era reading: skeuomorphic-quote (the beveled device bezel), but the flat gradient interior and lack of material realism keep the honest call at custom. Subject-mining is genuinely strong: the recess metaphor matches both the name (alcove) and the function (Dynamic Island black pill), which partly redeems the generic silhouette. The #10 mono failure is directly evidenced by the app's own grayscale cover badge. Cover paper ground #FEF1DF; wordmark badge runs a neutral grayscale palette (bezel #0C0A09, field #383330->#989085) while the app icon runs violet — one mark, two palettes.
